verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt index at docs.zapier.com, described as a local index for the SDK, MCP and integration docs. An llms-full.txt is also cited, and many doc pages are served as raw .md files (SDK quickstart, CLI, MCP connect, tool bundles, security), which is exactly the agent-ingestible documentation the story asks for. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
